meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: 让 Claude 驱动一个真实浏览器替你操作:在你已登录的站点上导航、填表、点击、截图、做网页 QA;也能另启一个自己拥有的浏览器做抓取、网络捕获,遇到登录或验证码时转交你本人。
howto.when: 遇到任何交互式浏览器任务时接管,例如操作你已登录的站点、填表点击、截图等。普通搜索或未被拦截的静态抓取不走它。

say.text: 打开我常登录的那个网站,帮我把表单填好并提交
say.note: 用你自己已登录的浏览器,不新建无痕环境

say.text: 登录这个网站,遇到验证码或短信码就叫我来弄
say.note: 会把登录、验证码、OTP 转交你本人完成

say.text: 把当前这个页面截个图给我

howto.what_en: Claude drives a real browser via omowright: navigate sites you are already signed into, fill forms, click, take screenshots and run web QA. It can also launch its own browser for scraping, network capture and traces, handing login or CAPTCHA back to you.
howto.when_en: Use it for any interactive browser task: acting on signed-in sites, forms, clicks, screenshots and the like. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open the site I'm usually signed into and fill in the form and submit it
say_en.note: Uses your own signed-in browser, no fresh profile

say_en.text: Log into this site and hand CAPTCHA or OTP over to me
say_en.note: Passes login, CAPTCHA and OTP to you

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page
say_en.note: Returns the shot plus width, height, captureId
